newsitem.title: NORWAY: FORECAST - Christania Q1 profits seen down.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Christania Q1 profits seen down.

text.p: Christiania Bank og Kreditkasse, Norway's second biggest bank, is expected to register first-quarter operating profits of 494 million crowns, down from 562 million in the same year-ago period, according to a forecast consensus by seven analysts polled by Reuters.
Six recommended a buy on the share while one suggested hold.
Christiania plans to merge with Storebrand, Norway's biggest insurance company, this year to form the biggest financial institution in the country.

Regardless of its tax dispute with the government over tax losses carried forward, Christiania will pay little tax this year. For next year, however, several analysts assume a much higher tax exposure and this reflects on their EPS forecasts.
Christiania will present the first-quarter result at 0630 GMT on Tuesday.
